name: mcp-servers
description: Monorepo for MCP server plugins and the fossil CLI workspace

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const p of fs.readdirSync('packages'))for(const d of ['dist','dist-test'])fs.rmSync('packages/'+p+'/'+d,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces && npm run test:dod-guard-skills && npm run test:separation
